title: The Outlook for AI-Related Stocks and US Interest Rates
executive_summary: Goldman Sachs' Muhammad Qubbaj discusses the outlook for US stocks and bonds, AI-related stocks, and interest rates, expressing a positive view on the equity market rally and not seeing concerns in rising bond issuance by tech companies and the US government.

risk_assessments: Rising bond issuance by tech companies and the US government
profile_data.market_outlook: Positive on US equity market rally, with a stable interest rate environment.
